scientific_integrity: The asserted novelty is the complete occupancy-dependent inverse classification of equality of two particle processes, the exceptional weighted-degree cone and the collision-time/pair-mark distinction, not the general change-of-measure or Doob-transform machinery of the cited papers. Analytic proof plus supplementary finite computation; no claims of independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Finite \(n\ge3\) and \(2\le k\le n-1\) with every directed rate positive. Sparse and infinite generators, nonconstant collision intensity and general multiparticle stationary observables are not classified. Classical finite-state Doob and inclusion-matrix arguments supply proof ingredients; an independent audit is outstanding.
title: Exact coincidence of exclusion and noncollision dynamics at the packing boundary
